verifications.claim: 7-Eleven is closing 645 underperforming convenience stores across North America in fiscal year 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '7-Eleven plans to close more than 600 stores in 2026' 'closing underperforming locations'; R5: 'shutter 645 locations during its 2026 fiscal year'; R6: 'close 645 convenience stores' in fiscal year 2026
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the exact number 645 closures of underperforming stores in FY2026 across North America.

verifications.claim: Seven & i Holdings is the parent company of 7-Eleven.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'parent company Seven & i Holdings’; R3: 'Seven & I Holdings, the chain’s Japan-based parent company'; R4: 'parent company Seven & i Holdings'

verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'closed about 444 stores... in 2024'; R3: 'shutting down 444 locations'; R4: 'shutter 444 underperforming stores... in 2024'
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently state 444 stores closed in 2024, not 474.

verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: Sources mention combined closures in 2024-2025 (>600 or 700) and projected closures of 373 (not confirmed as past tense in 2025), but no specific confirmation of 373 closed in 2025.

verifications.claim: 7-Eleven plans to open 205 new, improved stores in fiscal year 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'ramp things up next year with 205 openings'; R6: 'Next year, the chain is projected to open 205'
verifications.reasoning: Exact number and plans for new stores (implied improved format) in next year (FY2026 context) directly match.

verifications.claim: Some closed stores will be converted to wholesale fuel stores.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Some locations will also be converted to “wholesale fuel stores,”'; R4: 'Some will be turned into “wholesale fuel stores,”'; R5: 'some stores even morphing into so-called “wholesale fuel stores”'; R6: 'including as part of its transition to “wholesale fuel stores”'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state some stores converted to wholesale fuel stores.

verifications.claim: Wholesale fuel stores maintain fuel sales without the retail footprint.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: '“wholesale fuel stores,” which the company does not include in its store count'; R4: '“wholesale fuel stores,” a specific category that the company keeps separate from its official retail store count'; R5: '“wholesale fuel stores” — a format that won’t count toward the company’s official store total'
verifications.reasoning: Sources imply wholesale fuel stores are fuel-focused without retail convenience (separate from store count), but do not explicitly state 'maintain fuel sales without the retail footprint'.

verifications.claim: The closures are driven by declining cigarette sales.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3: 'decrease in cigarette purchases as the reasons'; R5: 'Weak cigarette sales... plunging 26% since 2019'
verifications.reasoning: Mentioned as one reason among others (e.g., traffic, inflation), not sole driver.

verifications.claim: The closures are driven by inflation.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'citing inflation'; R3: 'inflationary pressures'; R4: 'economic headwinds'; R5: 'inflation pressures'
verifications.reasoning: Listed as one factor among multiple reasons for closures.

verifications.claim: The closures are driven by a strategic shift toward larger, food-focused, and modern store formats.

verifications.evidence: R1: 'opening new ones under its large format, food-focused design'; R4: 'moving away from the small, traditional shops... betting on larger stores that focus heavily on fresh food'; R5: 'pivots... to full-on food destinations... larger footprints'; R6: 'moves to larger wholesale locations... expanded food and beverage offerings'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly describe closures as part of shift to larger, food-focused formats.

verifications.claim: Reasons for the closures include decreased consumer traffic.

verifications.evidence: R1: 'weaker traffic'; R3: 'declining traffic'; R4: 'weaker foot traffic'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly listed as a reason in sources.
